name: Ballad Concert v1
intent: Warm, natural concert-grand ballad; CFX-inspired direction, Yamaha C5 samples

velocity.mapping: round(127 * (v / 127)^1.13), clamp 1..127; note-on zero remains note-off

release_resonance: Original release samples at reduced levels; no physical sympathetic resonance
round_robin: Two random pedal noises only; note samples have no round robin
